Happy Wednesday! *Bitcoin* briefly surged above $69,000 this morning, shortly after *Bitget Research* chief analyst *Ryan Lee* told The Block that the cryptocurrency had room to "catch up" if softer yields and the dollar began to outweigh geopolitical risks.

In today's newsletter, the *SEC* proposes new crypto offering rules, *Ripple's Stuart Alderoty* says Sept. 15 will be a "bellwether" for the *Clarity Act* , *White House* crypto adviser *Patrick Witt* is "bullish" on the bill, and more.

Meanwhile, *bitcoin's* correction may be nearing an end ( https://www.theblock.co/news/markets/2026-08-18-bitcoin-correction-may-nearing-end-8-capitulation-signals-flashing-vaneck-412130?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ) with eight of 12 capitulation signals currently flashing, according to *VanEck*.

*⛰️ Reminder:* We're on the ground at *SALT's Blockchain Symposium* ( https://www.salt.org/events/wyoming-blockchain-symposium-2026?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ) in Jackson Hole Aug. 17-20, with exclusive interviews and coverage of the biggest stories shaping crypto and global finance.

*THE BIG ONE*

*🏛️ SEC proposes new crypto offering rules as Congress stalls on digital asset legislation*

( https://www.theblock.co/news/regulation/2026-08-18-sec-proposes-new-crypto-offering-rules-congress-stalls-digital-asset-legislation-412145?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters )

The *SEC* proposed a new rule, "Regulation Crypto Assets," that would carve out a tailored regime exempting certain digital asset offerings from securities law, as broader legislation stalls in Congress.

* The plan includes a "startup exemption" for offerings up to $5 million from registration for four years, and a "fundraising exemption" for offerings up to $75 million for a year.
* It also adds a safe harbor that allows a digital asset to no longer be classified as a security once certain conditions are met and it has "ceased all managerial efforts."

77707.body:
----------
_**Your Weekly Deep Dive into The World of Crypto**_

**August 19, 2026 · ****5 Min Read**

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/b93c0ccc-195c-427a-9815-c6ae3a317b48/WhaleTales_Market_Snapshot_Aug19.png?t=1787119385)
Caption: _As of August 19, 2026, Morning ET |  Sources: Coinglass, Alternative.me, SoSoValue_

## 📡** THIS WEEK IN CRYPTO**

**GM, Readers!**

Last week was open combat. This week? Quiet reshuffling. A contrarian whale crossed 1,000 BTC while everyone else de-risked. Old bitcoin from 2011 and 2013 kept stirring. Metaplanet went shopping for yen. BitMine added another 9,900 ETH.

Bitcoin closed on Sunday at around $62,818, per Coinglass, down roughly 3% w/w. Spot BTC ETFs bled $389.71M, reversing last week's $853.54M inflow. The bright spot: Solana ETFs still pulled in $10.26M as of August 14, per SoSoValue.

_**Let’s get into it...**_


----------View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/6c53930f-b4d7-4e7d-baee-6a88bb56a6da/image.png?t=1781097813)
Caption: 

----------
# 🐋 THE BIG WHALE MOVES

### **1. The Contrarian Whale Just Crossed 1,000 BTC**

Anonymous wallet 19pFLW[ purchased](https://x.com/lookonchain/status/2088179161647157436) another 300 BTC for $19.03M on August 14, per Lookonchain. That took its total to 1,120 BTC (about $70.4M), officially crossing the "whale" threshold while the rest of the market was selling. Identity still unknown.

This buyer has been methodical, adding into weakness while institutional ETF cash was exiting.

_**Whale Intel: **__When everyone de-risks, and one wallet keeps stacking, that is a signal worth watching._

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/3fe468e6-456e-4324-96c0-daaabfe01da7/image.jpeg?t=1787119444)
Caption: _Contrarian whale summary  |  Source: Lookonchain via X, August 14, 2026_

### **2. Dormant Bitcoin Wallets Keep Waking Up**

On August 10, Galaxy Research[ reported](https://x.com/glxyresearch/status/2086710127537627200) a wallet starting "14vMEC" that swept 26.96 BTC after 12.5 years of silence, a 7,975% gain. That followed a 500 BTC transfer from an[ 18TExP](https://x.com/lookonchain/status/2084278583066001823) wallet inactive for almost 12 years and a[ 49.97 BTC](https://x.com/glxyresearch/status/2085460095773598167) move by an address, dormant since 2011.

Not all of it is Coldcard-related, but the timing after the July 30 firmware exploit is hard to ignore. Most transfers land in fresh self-custody, not exchanges.

**Whale Intel: **Aged coins moving does not mean selling. Track destination wallets, not the transfers.

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/faab00da-f1b3-49b5-b707-ed6258246267/image.jpeg?t=1787119445)
